comparator_code.name: comparator_code
values:
Not applicable (for non-randomized studies)
333: A regimen comprised entirely of approved drugs that might be "wanted" for adding to the wiki - usually an experimental arm that might have superior efficacy (e.g., HR crosses 1 but UB is <=1.05)
555: A regimen that is present on the stub page, regardless of whether it contains approved and/or investigational drugs
666: A regimen comprised entirely of approved drugs being tested as an experimental arm, with results still pending
777: A regimen with at least one component that is investigational in all regulatory domains that is wanted if and when the investigational component is approved
888: A regimen comprised entirely of approved drugs that is definitely "wanted" for adding to the wiki
995: A regimen comprised of approved and/or investigational drugs that is "unwanted" for adding to the wiki - negative experimental arms, etc. The comparative design of the unwanted regimen is in-class-switch
996: A regimen comprised of approved and/or investigational drugs that is "unwanted" for adding to the wiki - negative experimental arms, etc. The comparative design of the unwanted regimen is out-of-class-switch
997: A regimen comprised of approved and/or investigational drugs that is "unwanted" for adding to the wiki - negative experimental arms, etc. The comparative design of the unwanted regimen is de-escalation 
998: A regimen comprised of approved and/or investigational drugs that is "unwanted" for adding to the wiki - negative experimental arms, etc. The comparative design of the unwanted regimen is escalation
999: A regimen comprised of approved and/or investigational drugs that is "unwanted" for adding to the wiki - negative experimental arms, etc. The comparative design of the unwanted regimen is unspecified.
